Full annual 2025 output verified from official archive across 6 published regular issues (89 unique research papers with valid DOIs). Reconciled with user's local catalog (vjmech_ojs_catalog.json, 88 records): the local catalog lacks issue groupings (catalog.issues is empty) and groups articles by online submission/posting date rather than published volume year. Consequently, the local catalog includes 16 unissued Online First articles (volume=None, issue=''), 6 of which were later assigned to 2026 issues and 10 remain unissued, while omitting 17 articles published in Vol. 63 (2025) whose online-first dates were in 2023 or 2024. All 89 articles in this dataset are verified directly from Vol. 63 No. 1-6 official issue pages.

Year-to-date 2026 output as of 2026-10-21 verified across 5 published regular issues (76 unique research papers with valid DOIs). Latest issue Vol. 64 No. 5 was published on 2026-10-20. Reconciled with user's local catalog (78 records): local catalog was exported prior to Vol. 64 No. 5 (which contains 15 articles, 12 new to local catalog) and includes 25 unissued Online First articles (volume=None, issue=''), while omitting 11 articles published in Vol. 64 whose online-first dates were in 2024 or 2025. Per contract, unassigned Online First articles are excluded until published in a numbered regular issue.

Year-to-date 2026 output as of 2026-10-21 across 3 published regular issues (20 research papers). Reconciled with local catalog (43 records total): exactly matches the 20 numbered issue articles; the 23 unassigned Online First articles are excluded per contract.

limitations: Year 2026 outputs represent published-to-date (YTD) counts as of 2026-10-21 and are partial annual volumes; per contract instructions, they must not be directly compared with full-year 2025 volumes as growth or decline.
Unassigned Online First articles (present on VJES, VJST, and VJMech platforms) are excluded per contract specification until officially assigned to a numbered published regular issue.

Non-research matter (cover pages, tables of contents, editorial announcements, memorials, errata, corrigenda) is excluded from eligible research paper counts (e.g. 1 memorial announcement in VJMech Vol. 47 No. 1).

Reconciliation with local user OJS citation catalogs (09-series): Local catalogs do not track issue structures (catalog.issues is empty) and group articles by initial online-submission/posting date rather than official published issue year. Furthermore, local exports reflect a frozen snapshot (processed 2026-10-19) that predates recent issue publications (such as VJST Vol. 64 No. 5 published 2026-10-20). These structural and temporal differences fully account for discrepancies between catalog record totals and official issue paper counts.

Indexing statuses marked with evidenceLevel 'journal' represent explicit claims posted on official journal websites/pages rather than independent direct database audits, whereas DOAJ entries and preserved Scopus records are directly verified at the database level.

VJMech is not part of the original 7-journal Scopus snapshot; its Scopus and WoS statuses are reported as unverified with honest source qualification rather than asserting non-indexing, adhering to the contract rule against inventing negative not_listed claims.
